tools.name: find_businesses
tools.description: Finds Gwiksoft businesses that sell what the customer is looking for, optionally in a city, with a few matching products from each. Each result’s business id works with the other tools. Online stores deliver beyond their city.

tools.name: get_business
tools.description: The business’s profile: what it sells, where it is, opening hours, how it sells (showroom, online store, bulk), whether it takes visits and has an online checkout, and its WhatsApp and chat links.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Searches the business’s whole catalogue by the customer’s words, a budget, or both. Returns each product’s current price in INR, options, stock and link, plus the business’s live offers. next_cursor gives the next page.

tools.name: list_collections
tools.description: The catalogue’s collections or categories, each with how many products it has, the lowest price and a photo.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: One product in full: photos, every option with its choices, and, for online stores, the variant for the chosen options with its id, price and stock. The variant id works with start_checkout.

tools.name: list_offers
tools.description: The business’s offers running now, with their end dates and terms. This is the complete list of its current offers.

tools.name: ask_business
tools.description: Answers delivery, returns, exchange, payment, warranty and care questions from what the business published: its FAQs, its website and, for Shopify stores, the store’s own policies. Says how to reach the team when it has no answer.

tools.name: start_checkout
tools.description: For online stores on Shopify: a link that opens the store’s own cart with the chosen products in the customer’s browser, with the total. The store confirms stock and the final price at checkout; nothing is ordered or charged by this tool. Other businesses answer with how to buy.

tools.name: create_lead
tools.description: Sends the customer’s enquiry or call-back request, with their name and phone, to the business’s team, who contact them on WhatsApp or by phone. For when the customer has asked to be contacted. Only for businesses that take requests through AI assistants; others answer with their WhatsApp and chat li

tools.name: request_visit
tools.description: Requests a store visit or appointment on the day and time the customer chose. It reaches the business’s Appointments board as pending, and the team confirms it with the customer. Not for online-only stores. Only for businesses that take requests through AI assistants; others answer with their WhatsA

tools.name: hand_off_to_team
tools.description: Passes the customer, with a short summary of what they need, to a person on the business’s team, who contacts them on WhatsApp or by phone. For when the customer asks for a person. Only for businesses that take requests through AI assistants; others answer with their WhatsApp and chat links.
